description: Header file defining the OgHttp2Adapter class, which implements an HTTP/2 adapter interface using quiche library components.

classes.name: OgHttp2Adapter
classes.description: A class implementing an HTTP/2 adapter interface using quiche library components, providing methods for HTTP/2 communication.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of OgHttp2Adapter with specified visitor and options.

methods.name: ~OgHttp2Adapter
methods.description: Destructor for OgHttp2Adapter.

methods.name: IsServerSession
methods.description: Checks if the session is a server session.

methods.name: want_read
methods.description: Indicates if the adapter wants to read data.

methods.name: want_write
methods.description: Indicates if the adapter wants to write data.

methods.name: ProcessBytes
methods.description: Processes incoming bytes.

methods.name: SubmitSettings
methods.description: Submits HTTP/2 settings.

methods.name: SubmitPriorityForStream
methods.description: Submits priority information for a stream.

methods.name: SubmitPing
methods.description: Submits a ping frame.

methods.name: SubmitShutdownNotice
methods.description: Submits a shutdown notice.

methods.name: SubmitGoAway
methods.description: Submits a GOAWAY frame.

methods.name: SubmitWindowUpdate
methods.description: Submits a window update for flow control.

methods.name: SubmitMetadata
methods.description: Submits metadata for a stream.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends data.

methods.name: GetSendWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the current send window size.

methods.name: GetStreamSendWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the send window size for a specific stream.

methods.name: GetStreamReceiveWindowLimit
methods.description: Returns the receive window limit for a stream.

methods.name: GetStreamReceiveWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the receive window size for a stream.

methods.name: GetReceiveWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the current receive window size.

methods.name: GetHpackEncoderDynamicTableSize
methods.description: Returns the HPACK encoder's dynamic table size.

methods.name: GetHpackEncoderDynamicTableCapacity
methods.description: Returns the HPACK encoder's dynamic table capacity.

methods.name: GetHpackDecoderDynamicTableSize
methods.description: Returns the HPACK decoder's dynamic table size.

methods.name: GetHpackDecoderSizeLimit
methods.description: Returns the HPACK decoder's size limit.

methods.name: GetHighestReceivedStreamId
methods.description: Returns the highest received stream ID.

methods.name: MarkDataConsumedForStream
methods.description: Marks data as consumed for a stream.

methods.name: SubmitRst
methods.description: Resets a stream with an error code.

methods.name: SubmitRequest
methods.description: Submits a request with headers and optional data.

methods.name: SubmitResponse
methods.description: Submits a response with headers and optional data.

methods.name: SubmitTrailer
methods.description: Submits trailer headers for a stream.

methods.name: SetStreamUserData
methods.description: Associates user data with a stream.

methods.name: GetStreamUserData
methods.description: Retrieves user data associated with a stream.

methods.name: ResumeStream
methods.description: Resumes a paused stream.
